Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: individual image-to-3D character reference for a medieval Japanese fantasy game called Enemys Name.
Create ONE standalone high-quality full-body character image. Avoid the look of primitive cylinders, spherical joints, a toy figurine, a mannequin, a blocky placeholder, a bobblehead, or an anime/chibi character.
Backdrop: perfectly plain warm-light-grey/off-white studio background with no horizon, scenery, objects, graphics or text. Very soft minimal contact shadow only.
Composition: ONE person only, entire body visible from the top of hair/hat to soles with generous even margins, centred, neutral near-front view with only about a 10-degree three-quarter angle. No dynamic action, no foreshortening. Camera at mid-torso height with orthographic-like perspective.
Lighting: soft balanced neutral studio illumination, readable face, no dramatic shadows or rim glow.
Color art direction: subdued indigo, moss, hemp, earth browns, aged ivory and dark iron; coherent medieval Japanese rural fantasy, quiet serious mystery story. No modern clothing, no European medieval armor, no giant fantasy accessories.
No labels, no writing, no layout, no reference sheet, no panels, no extra views, no inset portraits, no duplicate character, no weapons held. The image must look like a beautifully designed finished character, not the existing simplistic Blender mannequin.
Character-specific design: Japanese male age 27-32, lean athletic and capable, seven-head-tall adult proportions. Quiet grief and alert resolve, narrow brown eyes, a subtle healed eyebrow scar, dark hair pulled into a natural compact topknot with a few loose strands, clean-shaven. Fitted faded midnight-indigo crossed-collar kosode, ivory inner collar, dark brown woven obi, practical charcoal-indigo pleated hakama with controlled volume, worn brown forearm wraps, ivory split-toe tabi and low straw-soled sandals. Weathered hems and repaired stitching, restrained traditional rural warrior design. No armor and no weapons; empty hands.
Portrait canvas. Professional polished game character art, beautiful nuanced face, full figure occupies 85 percent of image height.
